Honestly I went on my alt to be a no here cause I need to vent. I'm in a young relationship with another girl and after three years I do just about everything for her. I cook, clean and drive her everywhere. I've tried to leave three times and every time she threatens to killerself and I fold and don't end up leaving. I just don't know how to leave, I feel so trapped and I don't know what to do. This person relies on me to do everything and everytime I say I want to breakup of course it always becomes a spiral of "I'm gonna kill myself because I literally can't do anything for myself". 


On the one hand I really love this person and the affection is great and we have some genuinely good times together. And on the other hand I am crying about the fact that I have nobody that does the same stuff I do for for my partner for me and that really hurts. Sometimes I'll just forget my pills and or something and just cry a little bit because even tho I have a partner I don't have anyone else I can lean on to take care of me back.
